standard.summary: 控制 LoRA 权重的初始化方式。default 使用 Kaiming 随机初始化；PiSSA 用 SVD 分解底模权重来初始化；OLoRA 用正交初始化；LoftQ 用量化感知初始化。
standard.effect: 好的初始化可以加速收敛并提升最终质量。PiSSA 通过 SVD 捕获底模的主要方向，通常比随机初始化收敛更快。
standard.whenToUse: default 适合大多数场景。PiSSA 在 finetune 和大数据集上有优势。OLoRA 在多概念训练中减少概念干扰。
standard.avoidWhen: PiSSA 初始化需要计算 SVD，大模型上可能耗时数分钟。LoftQ 需要量化相关依赖。

optionDescriptions.pissa: 按主奇异方向起手，常常更快进入有效子空间。
optionDescriptions.loftq: 对着量化底座做的初始化。

standard_en.summary: Controls how the LoRA weights are initialised. default uses Kaiming random init; PiSSA initialises from an SVD of the base weights; OLoRA uses an orthogonal init; LoftQ uses a quantisation-aware init.
standard_en.effect: A good initialisation speeds up convergence and can raise final quality. PiSSA captures the base model's principal directions through SVD and usually converges faster than a random init.
standard_en.whenToUse: default fits most cases. PiSSA has an edge on finetunes and large datasets. OLoRA reduces concept interference in multi-concept training.
standard_en.avoidWhen: PiSSA has to compute an SVD, which can take minutes on a large model. LoftQ needs the quantisation dependencies.

optionDescriptions.default: The default initialisation, with the widest compatibility.
optionDescriptions.pissa: Starts from the principal singular directions, often reaching a useful subspace sooner.
optionDescriptions.loftq: An initialisation built against a quantised base.

advanced.principle: PiSSA: 对底模权重 W 做 SVD 分解 W ≈ U·S·V^T，取前 r 个奇异值初始化 A = V[:r]·√S[:r]，B = √S[:r]·U[:r]^T。这使得 LoRA 初始状态就捕获了底模最重要的方向。pissa_svd_algo 控制 SVD 算法（rsvd 随机 SVD 更快）。OLoRA 使用 QR 分解生成正交初始化。LoftQ 在量化底模上做 LoRA 初始化。
advanced.intervention: 在 LoRA 注入阶段替换默认的 nn.init.kaiming_uniform_ 为 SVD/QR/量化感知初始化。
advanced.expectedImpact: PiSSA 在前 100 步的 loss 比 default 低约 10-20%，最终质量改善约 2-5%。
advanced.tradeoffs: pissa_cache_mode 控制是否在 checkpoint 中保存 PiSSA 状态。adapter_init_export_mode 控制导出时的格式。

advanced_en.principle: PiSSA: SVD-decomposes the base weight W ≈ U·S·V^T and takes the top r singular values to initialize A = V[:r]·√S[:r], B = √S[:r]·U[:r]^T, so the LoRA's initial state already captures the base model's most important directions. pissa_svd_algo selects the SVD algorithm (rsvd randomized SVD is faster). OLoRA uses QR decomposition for orthogonal initialization. LoftQ performs LoRA initialization on a quantized base model.
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces the default nn.init.kaiming_uniform_ at the LoRA injection stage with SVD/QR/quantization-aware initialization.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: PiSSA's loss over the first 100 steps is roughly 10-20% lower than default; final quality improves about 2-5%.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: pissa_cache_mode controls whether PiSSA state is saved in checkpoints. adapter_init_export_mode controls the export format.
